name: cosmos3-super

test_prompt: A robot arm carefully picks up a red cube from a table, smooth cinematic motion
skip: scaffold only — Cosmos 3 MoT (AR reasoner + DM generator + joint attention + ViT/VAE/action encoders) not yet implemented; remove this skip once the builders land and B200 validation passes
notes: Cosmos3-Super is a 64B Mixture-of-Transformers omni-model. The plugin currently raises NotImplementedError listing every missing builder. Bring-up sequence: (1) lock arch from config.json on a host with HF gated access; (2) AR reasoner TRT builder; (3) DM generator TRT builder (slot into sp_* parallel modes from #205); (4) ViT/VAE/action encoders; (5) C++ MoT runtime with interleaved AR↔DM joint attention. Targets nvidia/Cosmos3-Super on B200 8-GPU; Nano (16B) variant follows once Super lands.
